7e4d7ebb7a2ad499.description: About Almarai Almarai Company, established in 1977, is recognized as the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy company and the leading food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in the MENA region. Headquartered in Riyadh, Almarai is ranked as the number one FMCG Brand in the MENA region and holds a market leadership position across its categories in the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. The company employs over 43,000 professionals across these regions. Role Overview Almarai is seeking an Assistant IT Account Manager to join its team in Riyadh, KSA. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the quality of services provided by the Business Systems Division (BSD) through various initiatives. The position involves improving application quality, assisting in training material development, and coordinating service delivery. Core Purpose of the Job The primary purpose of this role is to enhance the quality of services offered by the BSD. This includes improving the quality of delivered applications, contributing to the development of training materials, measuring application performance, and facilitating coordination between IT Account Managers (ITAs) and Head Office to ensure prompt delivery of services required by the Division. Key Responsibilities Improve the quality of applications delivered by the BSD. Assist in the development of training materials for applications and services. Measure and report on application performance. Coordinate between IT Account Managers and Head Office to ensure timely service delivery. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field. 4-5 years of relevant experience in operations under Oracle with Windows and Unix environments, SQL Server, and MS Windows Operating Systems. Proven experience in software development, coupled with a strong background in management and team leadership. Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in software development or solution engineering. Minimum of 1 year of experience in AI, machine learning, or Generative AI development. Demonstrated hands-on experience in independently designing and building technical solutions, beyond managing vendors, projects, or delivery teams. Required Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (*, Excel, Word).

7e55b41073eb5a12.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Manager - Finance Ramp-up to lead the establishment of the finance function for an assigned asset. This full-time role (CORS372) involves overseeing the finance ramp-up from the initial pre-opening phase through to project handover, ensuring compliance and efficient launch processes. Role Overview and Objectives The primary objective of this position is to deliver the finance ramp-up for a designated asset, commencing with the pre-opening team and concluding with the official handover. This includes developing the finance function and team, ensuring adherence to financial regulations, and managing the launch, transition, and reporting frameworks. Key Responsibilities Manage the Finance ramp-up for the assigned asset, from kick-off with the pre-opening team to handover. Execute the ramp-up plan through meticulous planning and build phases, maintaining alignment with the go-live date. Develop and maintain the ramp-up project charter, encompassing scope, timeline, resourcing, budget, risks, and dependencies. Define the asset's Finance target operating model and workforce plan in collaboration with asset leadership. Act as the hiring manager during recruitment, then onboard and coach the asset Finance team as it forms. Guide the asset in adopting Qiddiya Finance policies, procedures, and interfaces, and validate any deviations from standard practices. Confirm data structures and system interfaces to QIC Finance. Provide launch and stabilization support at go-live, then formally close the project with a handover and documented learnings. Report progress and challenges to the Senior Ramp-up Manager and asset stakeholders, and support Steering Committee sign-off. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Type This is a full-time position within Qiddiya Investment Company. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this role to contribute to the financial ramp-up of key assets within Qiddiya Investment Company.

7e566cfb5b721596.description: About the Role Egis is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Environment Engineer to join its site team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on supporting environmental management and compliance activities, with a particular emphasis on construction environmental assurance, environmental monitoring, regulatory liaison, and stakeholder engagement. The Environment Engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to monitor environmental performance, analyze data, and ensure compliance with applicable environmental requirements. Key Responsibilities Coordinate the preparation and submission of periodic environmental compliance reports to NCEC, including six-monthly reporting. Compile environmental monitoring results, compliance status, corrective actions, and supporting records for regulatory submissions. Maintain oversight of commitments and conditions from environmental permits and NCEC requirements. Prepare or coordinate technical justifications for environmental monitoring exceedances, particularly for ambient air quality and noise. Support investigations of exceedances to identify potential sources and appropriate corrective and preventive measures. Prepare and coordinate close-out reports and remediation/corrective action reports related to NCEC observations, notices, or violations. Maintain documentation demonstrating closure of regulatory findings. Accompany and support NCEC representatives during environmental inspections and site visits. Coordinate project visits and meetings with NCEC, including preparing relevant technical information and compliance documentation. Develop and maintain an Environmental Permit Compliance Tracker covering applicable permit conditions, commitments, and monitoring/reporting requirements. Track the status of environmental permit conditions and identify upcoming compliance obligations. Coordinate with project parties to obtain information and evidence required for permit compliance. Identify potential environmental compliance gaps and escalate them to the Environmental Manager/Project Management Team. Oversee implementation of the project's Environmental Monitoring Programme in accordance with permits and approved plans. Collate and review monitoring data from contractors for completeness, consistency, and potential exceedances. Provide strategic and technical advice on site environmental monitoring, including requirements, locations, and responses to abnormal results. Flag monitoring exceedances or adverse trends requiring investigation or corrective action. Conduct regular environmental inspections and audits of contractors and subcontractors. Monitor contractors' implementation of environmental controls and requirements on site. Participate in environmental coordination meetings with contractors and PMC environmental representatives. Follow up environmental observations, non-conformances, and corrective actions through to closure. Coordinate with contractors and PMC environmental representatives for the collection of environmental monitoring data and records for compliance reporting. Review contractors' environmental documentation, including Construction Environmental and Social Management Plans (CESMPs) and Construction Environmental Management Plans (CEMPs). Review subsequent revisions and supporting environmental procedures, method statements, and plans relevant to project environmental compliance. Deliver or coordinate environmental induction, awareness sessions, toolbox talks, and training for contractor environmental resources and other relevant site personnel. Develop environmental awareness material addressing project-specific environmental risks, permit conditions, and good environmental practices. Support capacity building of key contractor personnel and Saudi national staff involved in environmental management and compliance. Promote consistent understanding of environmental responsibilities among contractors and subcontractors. Reinforce lessons learned from inspections, monitoring exceedances, environmental incidents, and NCEC observations through targeted awareness sessions. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree (BSc) in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or a similar discipline. A postgraduate qualification in an environmental or related discipline is preferred. Minimum of 8 years of relevant professional environmental experience. Experience in the GCC and Saudi Arabia, including construction environmental assurance and environmental monitoring. Strong knowledge of environmental regulations, compliance standards, and permitting processes applicable to Saudi Arabia. Demonstrated experience in regulatory liaison and engagement with relevant authorities in Saudi Arabia. Required Skills Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex environmental data. Strong stakeholder engagement skills, including effective coordination with clients, contractors, consultants, and multidisciplinary project teams. Strong data analysis and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate environmental monitoring and compliance information clearly. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are preferred. Attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working as part of a site team and collaborating with various project stakeholders. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

7e63d9fea343901d.description: About the Role WSP is seeking an experienced Associate or Associate Director for Bridges & Tunnels to join its Transport & Infrastructure design team. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves a senior technical and design leadership role in delivering complex bridges, tunnels, and transportation structures across the region. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership throughout the design lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design through preliminary and detailed design, design review, and construction-stage technical support. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the design of bridges, tunnels, and associated transportation structures, ensuring solutions are technically robust, buildable, economical, and appropriate for the local environment. Provide technical leadership across concept, preliminary, and detailed design stages, including structural analysis, design development, verification, and technical reviews. Review and approve engineering calculations, design reports, drawings, specifications, and other technical deliverables. Ensure designs comply with applicable Saudi Arabian requirements and recognized international design standards and codes. Lead Bridges & Tunnels packages on major multidisciplinary infrastructure projects, establishing design programs, deliverables, resources, and technical responsibilities. Manage design changes and identify technical, program, and commercial risks, supporting the resolution of complex design and interface issues. Lead, manage, and mentor engineers and designers within the Bridges & Tunnels team, providing technical guidance and supporting succession planning. Develop strong relationships with clients, authorities, and project stakeholders, representing WSP at technical workshops and client meetings. For the Associate Director level, responsibilities also include a stronger focus on client relationships, commercial performance, strategic team development, and identifying future opportunities. Qualifications and Experience For Associate level: 15+ years of relevant engineering experience, predominantly in bridge, tunnel, or transportation structures design. For Associate Director level: 20+ years of relevant experience, including significant technical/design leadership responsibilities. Strong experience within an engineering consultancy/design environment, with proven delivery of major bridge, tunnel, and/or transportation structure design projects. Strong understanding of structural engineering principles covering reinforced concrete, prestressed concrete, and steel structures. Experience in the design of structures such as highway bridges, interchanges, underpasses, cut-and-cover structures, and tunnels. Ability to lead multidisciplinary design coordination and resolve complex interfaces. Strong understanding of design assurance, independent checking, and technical governance processes. Experience managing engineering teams and coordinating resources across multiple projects. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence to engage senior clients and stakeholders. Previous experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East is highly desirable. Technical Capabilities Strong knowledge of relevant bridge and structural design tools such as MIDAS, RM Bridge, SOFiSTiK, LUSAS, PLAXIS, or equivalent packages. Experience should ideally include structural analysis and finite element modeling, bridge and transportation structure design, reinforced and prestressed concrete design, and steel structure design. Proficiency in foundations and soil-structure interaction, seismic and dynamic design considerations, and design of underground and retaining structures. Experience in design review and independent checking, as well as BIM/digital engineering environments and multidisciplinary model coordination. Commercial and Business Development Particularly at the Associate Director level, this role involves supporting the growth of WSP's Bridges & Tunnels capability within Saudi Arabia. This includes identifying opportunities with existing and prospective clients, supporting and leading technical inputs into bids and proposals, and contributing to fee estimates and resource plans. The role also monitors project financial performance and assists in developing the longer-term strategy and capability of the Bridges & Tunnels team. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this role within WSP's Transport & Infrastructure design team.

7e7bac080b650aa5.description: About Bulgari Middle East Bulgari, established in 1884, is recognized for its creations inspired by Roman heritage, featuring colored gemstone combinations and innovative designs. Bulgari Middle East is seeking retail professionals to join its team in Jeddah and Makkah. Role Overview The Client Advisor and Sales Support role focuses on providing a high-level shopping experience to clients and maximizing sales opportunities. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and involves supporting boutique operations, demonstrating product knowledge, and contributing to key performance indicators. Key Responsibilities Welcome all clients and prospects, providing service for browsing, purchases, after-sales, or complaints. Understand client needs and offer customized advice while introducing them to the Brand. Develop relationships with existing clients and engage new customers. Manage the sales process from welcome to packaging, applying selling techniques to ensure a unique shopping experience. Contribute to the achievement of store and service KPIs. Register client data for future contact, personalized CRM actions, and client development. Perform all CRM one-to-one activities. Apply all sales-related procedures and guidelines. Ensure front areas of the shop are clean and products are displayed according to visual merchandising guidelines. Handle After Sales service front office activities, including taking items for repair, conducting interviews, entering data into SAP, and ensuring customer satisfaction. Complete online training modules and participate in training sessions to develop product and brand knowledge. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a committed, organized, and driven team player. This role requires strong customer service and negotiation skills, along with integrity and respect to ensure operational effectiveness. Essential qualities include strong business awareness and the ability to network for prospective clients outside the store to build the client base. Knowledge of Bulgari products, selling skills, and store procedures is considered an advantage.

7e809c4a9ab923ea.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث فندق ديار الحبيب الفندقية عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ ومراقبة إجراءات وأنظمة الموارد البشرية، مع التركيز على دوام الموظفين، الإجازات، وتحديث البيانات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بأنواعها المختلفة، وتعديل النماذج حسب الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية، المرضية، الطارئة، وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات، الإعارة، وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق جميع البيانات كالتوظيف، الترقيات، الدورات التدريبية، والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية أو دور مشابه. فهم قوي لإجراءات وأنظمة الموارد البشرية. القدرة على التعامل مع شكاوى واستفسارات الموظفين بمهنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية ممتازة. دقة في إعداد وتحديث البيانات والتقارير. مهارات تواصل فعالة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، ويوفر فرصة للعمل في قطاع الفنادق ضمن بيئة ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

7e9a4728767c99ef.description: About the Role LanceSoft Middle East is seeking a Resident Engineer DWDM / OTN / GSC to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a contract position for a professional with 5-10 years of experience. The Resident Engineer serves as the primary coordination focal point between the Design/Wholesale and Deliver teams, ensuring seamless project execution. Key Responsibilities Directly responsible for maintaining the Technical Detailed Design (TDD). Directly responsible for maintaining DCN plans. Tracking infrastructure dependencies, including Outside Plant (OSP), Equipment Installation Room (EIR), site readiness, and power. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant engineering role. Demonstrated expertise in DWDM, OTN, and GSC technologies. Proven ability to manage and track complex infrastructure dependencies. Work Type and Location This is a contract position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires a professional who can effectively coordinate between various technical and delivery teams. 7ece2eb75138222c.description: About Lamdax Lamdax specializes in developing scalable digital solutions that enhance business processes and enable organizations to convert data into actionable decisions. The company's work integrates software, data, and practical business impact, assisting organizations in leveraging technology for more effective operations and informed decision-making. About the AI Engineer Role Lamdax is seeking a Fresh Graduate AI Engineer to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience who are eager to apply academic knowledge and project experience within a collaborative software environment. The AI Engineer will contribute to building AI solutions that support real business applications, working closely with technical teams and stakeholders to develop practical, data-driven solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop and test machine learning models for business applications and insights. Support the deployment and monitoring of AI solutions in production environments. Document experiments, model performance, and technical findings for team review. Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions. Prepare, clean, and analyze datasets for AI model development. Required Qualifications and Skills Fresh graduate with a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience from internships, university projects, or personal projects in developing and testing machine learning models. Working knowledge of Python, SQL, and .NET. Experience with at least one major AI or machine learning framework such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, or Hugging Face. Experience with data cleaning, preprocessing, feature engineering, exploratory analysis, or working with structured business datasets. Exposure to model deployment or monitoring, APIs, Docker, or cloud services. Ability to work with software engineers and help translate business needs into practical AI use cases. Experience turning operational data into business insights is a plus. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Candidates based elsewhere in Saudi Arabia, or in Cairo or elsewhere in Egypt, are also encouraged to apply.

7ef7406980effdca.description: About the Role Beijing Foreign Enterprise Management Consultants is seeking a Retail Store Manager to lead a Huawei flagship store in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves managing store operations, driving sales, and enhancing the brand image within the ICT sector. Key Responsibilities Manage Huawei flagship stores and contribute to building and enabling the global/regional/country self-operated system. Lead and promote innovation from an overall store perspective, developing strategies and solutions to improve brand image and store influence. Position and analyze internal and external environments, developing and optimizing store operation strategies and personnel deployment with a consumer-centric view. Manage internal and external compliance and risks to ensure healthy and legal store operations. Monitor development trends and competitor dynamics, formulating strategies adapted to the store's business circle and coordinating resources to achieve overall operational objectives. Build the store talent supply chain, lead store management in talent reservation, and foster a talent incubation base. Motivate and stimulate employees' internal drive, enhancing organizational vitality. Oversee on-site management, providing high-quality experiences and services for consumers, and continuously building industry benchmarks. Identify current and future customer requirements by establishing rapport with potential and actual customers. Take full responsibility for sales section results, including B2B target achievement, execution of marketing and layout, and store sales target achievement. Manage rotation tasks for Back to House, Marketing, and Team Management. The position requires a proven ability to manage complex store operations and lead teams effectively. 5-10 years of experience in retail store management. Demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets and manage operational compliance. Experience in talent development and team motivation. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, working within a dynamic retail environment for a globally recognized ICT company.

7e3f8234528f7075.description: About the Role Westin is seeking a Sales Coordinator to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on supporting the Sales & Marketing department through various administrative and client-facing tasks. The role involves maintaining brand image and ensuring guest loyalty while maximizing revenue. Prepare sales-related documents such as proposals, contracts, and banquet event orders throughout the sales process. Promote awareness of the brand image both internally and externally. Gather materials and assemble information packages, including brochures and promotional items. Utilize sales techniques to maximize revenue while maintaining existing guest loyalty to Marriott. Enter, retrieve, reconcile, and verify information (*, commissions, leads, third parties) using sales process software. Answer guest questions regarding property facilities and services, including hours of operation, rates, room types, packages, promotions, entertainment, restaurants, and special events. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, communicating via phone and email to address questions and requests. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address service needs, and express genuine appreciation. Develop and maintain positive working relationships, support team goals, and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. They possess an optimistic and adventurous outlook, aligning with Westin's commitment to empowering guests to enhance their well-being during travel. This role requires individuals who can bring the brand's unique programming to life and embrace well-being practices. Experience and Qualifications 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Ability to perform general office duties and support sales processes effectively. Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. Proficiency in using software involved in sales processes for data entry and verification. Commitment to Diversity Marriott International is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. The company fosters an environment where the unique backgrounds of associates are valued and celebrated, recognizing that its greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of its associates. Westin is committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

7ea0ea38230ecd0b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الشارع السادس للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بناء علاقات مع العملاء، تقديم عروض البيع، وإتمام عمليات البيع، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تحصيل الديون. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. الغرض من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات، وإعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين. كما يتولى مسؤولية التواصل المباشر مع العملاء لتقديم عروض البيع وإتمام الصفقات، مع ضمان متابعة العملاء وتحصيل المستحقات وإعداد التقارير الدورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، بما في ذلك بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء من خلال الزيارات الميدانية أو الاتصالات الهاتفية لترويج المنتجات والخدمات، وتقديم عروض البيع مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية المختصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. يتطلب الدور العمل الميداني والتواصل المباشر مع العملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

7e07c9ec60d3ae4a.description: إعلان وظيفي | مدير حملات إعلانية نبحث عن مدير حملات إعلانية يمتلك خبرة عملية في إدارة الحملات الرقمية، وربط أدوات التتبع والتحليل، ومتابعة الأداء الإعلاني وتحسين النتائج، مع إلمام متقدم بمنصات التسويق وقياس التحويلات. المهام والمسؤوليات: تخطيط وإدارة الحملات الإعلانية على مختلف المنصات الرقمية. إعداد وربط أدوات التتبع (Tracking & Pixels). إدارة روابط التتبع والتحويلات عبر منصة Thunder. التعامل مع منصة WebEngage وإعداد حملات التفاعل والأتمتة. إعداد وربط أكواد التتبع بين المتجر والمنصات الإعلانية. مراقبة أداء الحملات وتحليل النتائج ومؤشرات الأداء (KPIs). تحسين الحملات لرفع المبيعات ومعدل التحويل وتقليل تكلفة الاستحواذ. إعداد التقارير الدورية وتقديم التوصيات لتحسين الأداء. التأكد من دقة بيانات التتبع وسلامة الربط بين الأنظمة والمنصات. شروط ومتطلبات الوظيفة: خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في إدارة الحملات الإعلانية الرقمية. خبرة متقدمة في أدوات التتبع والربط والتحويلات. إجادة استخدام منصة Thunder لإدارة روابط التتبع وقياس النتائج. خبرة في منصة WebEngage وإدارة حملات تفاعل العملاء. معرفة عملية بأدوات Google Analytics 4 وGoogle Tag Manager. خبرة في Meta Ads وTikTok Ads وGoogle Ads. القدرة على إعداد Pixel وConversion API وربط الأحداث. فهم متقدم لمؤشرات الأداء الإعلاني وتحليل البيانات. مهارة إعداد التقارير وتحليل العائد على الإنفاق الإعلاني (ROAS). القدرة على العمل وفق أهداف ومؤشرات أداء واضحة. مهارات عالية في التحليل وحل المشكلات وإدارة الوقت. وجود خبرة في إدارة الحملات الإعلانية للمتاجر الإلكترونية. خبرة في ربط منصات التسويق مع سلة . القدرة على اكتشاف ومعالجة مشاكل التتبع وقياس التحويلات.

7ea22d2daa20f3b9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايديكس الدولية للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وإعداد برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل والمشاريع الصناعية. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الدراسات والتحاليل الفنية، وعرضها ومناقشتها مع الأطراف المعنية. حفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة درجة جامعية في الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. معرفة قوية بمبادئ التصميم الكهربائي وشبكات النقل والتوزيع. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية وتحديد حلولها. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في إعداد المخططات والتصاميم الفنية. القدرة على إعداد برامج تشغيل وصيانة المعدات الكهربائية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لحل المشكلات الفنية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة للعمل ضمن فريق وعرض النتائج. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي في هذا الدور بدوام كامل ضمن مشاريع شركة ايديكس الدولية للمقاولات في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور متابعة ميدانية لضمان جودة التنفيذ والصيانة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

7eae1fbae52b3924.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking an F&B Sales Ambassador to join their team in Jeddah. Utilize sales techniques to maximize revenue while preserving existing guest loyalty. Identify opportunities to upsell and enhance the Marriott experience or event for guests. Perform general office duties to support Sales & Marketing, including filing, sending emails, typing, and faxing. Enter, retrieve, reconcile, and verify information such as commissions, leads, and third-party data within sales software. Gather materials and assemble information packages, including brochures and promotional items. Determine and provide complimentary items to guests as tokens of appreciation for their patronage. Prepare sales-related documents throughout the sales process, such as proposals, contracts, or banquet event orders. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, communicating via phone and email to address questions and requests. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Adhere to all company policies and procedures, maintain a professional appearance, ensure confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards, anticipate and address service needs, and express genuine appreciation. Communicate professionally, prepare accurate written documents, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships, support team goals, and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of relevant experience. Ability to read and visually verify information in various formats. Capability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 10 pounds without assistance. With a heritage spanning over 100 years, originating in 1906 under the Italian CIGA brand, The Luxury Collection continuously evolves to meet the expectations of luxury travelers. Each hotel and resort serves as a unique expression of its locale, providing a gateway to the destination’s cultural charms and treasures. The team values evocative storytelling, a keen interest in destination heritage, and a commitment to delivering genuine, personalized, and anticipatory hospitality. Working at Marriott International By joining The Luxury Collection, you become part of the Marriott International portfolio of brands. Marriott International fosters an environment where employees can perform their best work, fulfill their purpose, belong to a global team, and develop professionally.

7ec7bd07f955ebab.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems professional to join their team in Riyadh. This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on the on-site commissioning and integration of SCADA systems. Key Responsibilities Execute on-site commissioning of SCADA systems. Perform I/O checks, loop testing, logic verification, and SCADA HMI validation. Validate communication protocols such as Modbus, IEC 61850, IEC 104, and DNP3. Coordinate with system integrators, OEM vendors, and internal teams to ensure seamless integration of automation and protection systems. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to control signals, communication links, and data reporting. Ensure system compliance with client requirements and utility/grid code standards. Generate commissioning test reports, punch point lists, and comprehensive documentation. Support remote SCADA integration and FAT/SAT activities as required. Provide training and technical support to site O&M staff during system handover. Experience Required Candidates should possess 0-1 years of experience in Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems, with a focus on commissioning and integration tasks. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the successful candidate will be involved in on-site activities and coordination with various stakeholders.

7edc2b2671b5054c.description: About the Role of Director of Fintech HungerStation is seeking a Director of Fintech to lead and oversee the development and implementation of financial technology solutions. The role requires a seasoned professional with over 10 years of experience in the field. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute HungerStation’s financial technology strategy, aligning with business growth, digital transformation, and customer experience objectives. Lead the design and implementation of scalable fintech solutions for high-volume transactions across customers, merchants, riders, and internal finance operations. Drive innovation in payment systems, digital wallets, refunds, settlements, and reconciliation processes to ensure speed, accuracy, and reliability. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, and Finance teams to integrate fintech solutions into HungerStation’s platform and operational workflows. Ensure compliance with Saudi regulatory requirements (SAMA, ZATCA, VAT, data protection) and Delivery Hero group policies, while managing fintech-related risks. Oversee fraud detection, transaction monitoring, and cybersecurity measures for financial systems and digital payments. Manage the fintech budget, focusing on cost efficiency, ROI optimization, and sustainable investment in new technologies and partnerships. Analyze financial and transaction data to identify trends, revenue opportunities, cost optimization areas, and system performance improvements. Prepare executive-level financial technology reports and dashboards, providing insights on transaction performance, risk exposure, and innovation impact. Lead and develop a high-performing fintech team, fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement. Stay informed on emerging fintech trends (open banking, embedded finance, BNPL, digital wallets, AI-driven fraud prevention) and assess their relevance. Build and manage strategic relationships with banks, payment providers, fintech startups, and regulatory bodies. Support business expansion by enabling new financial products and services for merchants and customers. Strategy and Governance Contribute to the development and execution of divisional objectives and key results (OKRs), ensuring alignment across functions. Make critical decisions supporting the division’s strategic and tactical direction. Establish plans for respective functions/teams and provide input for divisional goals. Distribute tactical responsibilities to potential leaders to enhance organizational succession readiness. Measure and track relevant OKRs and metrics, taking corrective actions as needed. Adhere to all relevant policies, procedures, and processes for controlled and consistent daily operations. Identify opportunities for continuous process improvement to enhance effectiveness. Maintain a high-performance working environment and promote HungerStation’s values. People and Budget Management Set performance objectives, provide support, evaluate direct reports, and offer regular feedback. Participate in the identification and recruitment of key talents for the function. Provide clear direction, prioritize tasks, assign and delegate responsibility, and monitor workflow. Offer opportunities for team members to contribute to improvement, innovation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Manage and own the budgeting cycle, providing input to the budgeting process. Ensure effective utilization of the function's budget and report accurately on progress and challenges. Investigate and propose strategies for positive financial impact and mitigate financial and operational risks. Required Qualifications Experience: 10-12 years of relevant experience. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Fintech, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.

This full-time role involves driving occupancy and revenue by executing leasing strategies and managing the full leasing cycle from inquiry to move-in. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving occupancy targets and delivering customer service to prospective and current residents. Key Responsibilities Execute leasing strategies to achieve and maintain occupancy targets. Generate leads through proactive marketing, networking, and outreach activities. Respond to all leasing inquiries and conduct property viewings, showcasing compound features and amenities. Negotiate lease terms, pricing, and conditions in line with approved rental guidelines, and secure signed lease agreements. Achieve monthly leasing targets and conversion rate objectives, maintaining detailed pipeline tracking and providing weekly activity reports. Conduct market tours and competitive analysis to support pricing recommendations. Develop and maintain relationships with corporate clients, relocation agencies, and HR departments, including preparing corporate leasing proposals. Implement digital and traditional marketing campaigns, manage online property listings, and maintain social media presence. Coordinate photography, videography, and virtual tour content for marketing materials, and develop marketing collateral. Prepare and execute lease agreements in compliance with KSA regulations, including Ejar and Shomoos registration. Collect security deposits, advance rent, and required tenant documentation, verifying tenant identification and employment. Coordinate move-in scheduling, conduct pre-move-in unit inspections, and deliver welcome kits and resident orientation. Maintain show units in pristine condition, coordinating staging, furnishing, and décor updates. Proactively manage lease expiry calendars and initiate renewal conversations, achieving lease renewal targets. Conduct regular market surveys and competitive benchmarking, preparing monthly leasing reports and analyzing trends. 7e16fc746e783667.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a Supervisor, Furnace to oversee furnace operations in Dammam. This full-time role involves ensuring production control, coordinating the furnace team, and maintaining safety compliance. The Supervisor will also be responsible for technical monitoring and reporting on furnace performance. Key Responsibilities Monitor furnace operation across all shifts, from charging to discharging, ensuring heating practices meet required billet discharge temperature and uniformity. Review and validate daily heat-wise charging sequences for each furnace, ensuring correct execution and minimal deviations from the plan. Analyze furnace stoppages, delays, and yield losses, defining root causes using analytical tools and driving corrective actions. Allocate and supervise pusher operators, ejector operators, and senior furnace operators to maintain continuous operation and coverage. Plan shift schedules, rotations, and leaves to avoid manpower gaps and maintain furnace availability. Ensure effective communication between the furnace team, billet handling, main pulpit, maintenance, and shift-in-charge. Review shift reports for gas consumption, billet movement, and temperature trends, verifying completeness and accuracy. Monitor gas manifold station condition, furnace equipment status, and key SCADA parameters, escalating abnormalities to mechanical and electrical teams. Coordinate planned shutdowns, scaling campaigns, and inspection activities with production and maintenance. Enforce safety requirements, including PPE, safe access, hot-work controls, LOTO, and confined-space rules. Ensure work areas around furnaces are kept clean, organized, and compliant with 5S standards. Coordinate with Environmental, Reliability, and Loss Prevention teams for inspections, stack readings, and audits. Consolidate furnace information into daily or shift reports for the Mill Engineer / Production Manager. Identify opportunities to improve heating schedules, energy efficiency, and furnace reliability, and support the implementation of improvement actions. Additional Duties Deputize for the Furnace Superintendent during their absence as assigned. Support training and onboarding of new furnace operators and senior operators. Participate in incident investigations and corrective-action follow-up related to furnace operations. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong understanding of reheating furnace operation, fuel systems, and billet heating practices. Ability to read and interpret production plans, SCADA trends, and furnace performance data. Leadership and coordination skills for managing multi-shift furnace teams. Solid EHS awareness, particularly regarding gas-fired equipment, high temperatures, and hot-work hazards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic industrial setting that requires adherence to strict safety and operational protocols.

Monitor construction progress and resolve technical issues related to landscape works. Ensure all landscape works meet project requirements and quality expectations. 7eb38ea41b25c6d4.description: About the Role Plaza Premium Group is seeking a Kitchen Planner Supervisor to be based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, with coverage across the Middle East. Conduct site visits to ensure design implementation aligns with approved drawings and quality standards. Coordinate with contractors to resolve design-related issues in a timely manner. Oversee the development of detailed kitchen design drawings and documentation. Ensure high-quality detailing, finishes, materials, and overall design accuracy. Maintain organized design documentation, revisions, and records. Stakeholder Management Liaise with clients, consultants, and contractors to ensure effective communication. Present design concepts, materials, and updates to stakeholders as required. Support project leadership with design input and reporting. Proficiency in reviewing and validating kitchen and F&B design drawings. Experience with on-site supervision and resolving design-related issues during construction. Strong detailing and documentation skills. Effective stakeholder management and communication abilities.

7e8ff219537d4a4e.job_title: Applications Quality Assurance & DevOps Senior Specialist
7e8ff219537d4a4e.description: About the Role Nahdi Medical Co. is seeking an Applications Quality Assurance & DevOps Senior Specialist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah Region. This full-time role is central to ensuring the quality of software products through meticulous testing and quality assurance activities, as well as maintaining and improving DevOps practices. The specialist will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project requirements. Key Responsibilities Conduct functional, regression, performance, security, and usability testing across all in-scope applications to verify functionality and identify defects. Design, develop, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project requirements and risk-based testing priorities. Identify, track, document, and communicate defects using defect tracking tools (JIRA/Xray, Zephyr, TestRail), and collaborate with development teams for timely resolution. Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation, including test plans, test cases, scripts, and results, to ensure coverage, traceability, and knowledge transfer. Set up and configure test environments and test data to simulate real-world scenarios for accurate and reliable testing. Adhere to QA standards, quality gates, and mandatory release deliverables defined by the COE (Test Strategy, Test Plan, Execution Report, Defect Summary, Production Readiness Sign-off). Develop and execute automated test scripts using QA frameworks and tools (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, TestNG, Cucumber, Postman, REST Assured) and contribute to the shared automation framework. Embed automated regression suites as mandatory quality gates in CI/CD pipelines, supporting the target of 60%+ automation coverage for critical applications. Operate and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI), including build, test, deployment, and release automation, and enforce the DevOps compliance framework (source control, branching, environment and release management). Monitor and report DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR) and contribute to monthly DevOps compliance scorecards. Execute application security testing (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning) within CI/CD pipelines, identify and document vulnerabilities, and support remediation tracking with IT Security in line with OWASP Top 10. Support the Segregation of Duties (SoD) exercise by validating access controls, role configurations, and SoD test cases during release validation in coordination with Internal Audit and IT Security. Support audit and compliance readiness (*, ISO 27001) by maintaining test evidence, release documentation, and reconciliation records, and support the integration reconciliation function between different applications and third-party platforms. Contribute to the Application Portfolio Register, lifecycle dashboard, and monthly Application Excellence Scorecard by providing QA, DevOps, release, and security metrics for assigned applications. Collaborate with development teams, product managers, business stakeholders, IT Security, Internal Audit, and the COE leadership; participate in Agile ceremonies; promote shift-left testing practices; and continuously improve QA, DevOps, and security processes while staying current with emerging methodologies and tools. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in Applications Quality Assurance and DevOps. Demonstrated ability to design and execute comprehensive test plans and cases. Proficiency with defect tracking tools such as JIRA/Xray, Zephyr, or TestRail. Experience with QA automation frameworks and tools including Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, TestNG, Cucumber, Postman, or REST Assured. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools like Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI. Understanding of application security testing methodologies (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning). Work Environment This is a full-time position with a work schedule of 5 days per week, totaling 8 hours per day (8:00 AM – 6:00 PM with a 1-hour break). The role is based entirely indoors.

7eaf0b6f52874e1c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كدن للمقاولات عن مدير ضيافة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى مدير الضيافة مسؤولية تطوير الخطط والإجراءات التشغيلية لضمان سير عمليات الضيافة بكفاءة وفعالية عالية. يشمل الدور الإشراف المباشر على جميع جوانب تخطيط وتنظيم وإدارة أعمال الضيافة، بما يتماشى مع الأهداف التشغيلية المحددة للشركة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير وتنسيق الخطط والإجراءات التشغيلية لموظفي إدارة الضيافة، وتحديد المهام والمسؤوليات وتوزيعها عليهم. الإشراف العام على أداء فرق عمل الضيافة، ومتابعة التزامهم بأساليب الضيافة المعتمدة، وضمان توافق مستوى الخدمات المقدمة مع معايير الجودة. متابعة وتقييم نظافة أماكن تحضير الأطعمة والمشروبات، وضمان الالتزام التام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة المهنية. مراجعة وتقييم الكميات المتوفرة من المواد الأولية اللازمة لتحضير الأطعمة والمشروبات، وضمان توافرها لتجنب أي نقص. الإشراف على إعداد التقارير الفنية الدورية حول مشكلات وتحديات العمل، واقتراح الحلول والإجراءات التصحيحية المناسبة. المهام التشغيلية يتولى مدير الضيافة متابعة كافة العمليات المعتمدة في مجال الضيافة، مع ضمان توفير جميع الموارد التقنية والبشرية الضرورية. يهدف ذلك إلى ضمان سير العمليات اليومية بأقصى درجات الكفاءة والفعالية الممكنة، وتحقيق الأهداف الموضوعة للقسم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الضيافة أو إدارة العمليات ذات الصلة. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والإجراءات التشغيلية. مهارات إشرافية ممتازة لإدارة فرق العمل وتقييم الأداء. معرفة بمعايير الجودة والنظافة والسلامة المهنية في قطاع الأغذية والمشروبات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل مدير الضيافة ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تقديم أفضل مستويات الخدمة في جميع عمليات الضيافة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن يمتلكون المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة للتقدم لهذه الوظيفة.

7eb235cdf1f4a1e9.description: المسمى الوظيفي: حارس أمن القسم: الأمن والسلامة المسؤول المباشر: مشرف الأمن المتطلبات الوظيفية: المؤهل العلمي: شهادة الثانوية العامة أو ما يعادلها. الخبرة: يُفضّل وجود خبرة سابقة في مجال الأمن. اللياقة الصحية: لياقة بدنية وحالة صحية تسمحان بأداء مهام الوظيفة. المهارات المطلوبة: الاستعداد للعمل بنظام الورديات (صباحية، مسائية، ليلية). الانتباه للتفاصيل وحسن التصرف في الحالات الطارئة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والتعامل مع الآخرين. القدرة على تحمل ضغط العمل. متطلبات إضافية: توفر وسيلة مواصلات للتنقل بين الفروع عند الحاجة. الراتب الشهري: 4,500 ريال سعودي. ساعات العمل: 9 ساعات يوميًا، تشمل ساعة راحة. أيام العمل: 6 أيام عمل أسبوعيًا، ويوم راحة واحد. مكان العمل: فروع بن داود والدانوب، حسب احتياج العمل في كل فرع.

7e06040f3cf49a3d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة عبدالرحمن زايد القرموشي التجارية عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة العمليات المحاسبية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المالية، متابعة الإيرادات، وتدقيق الحسابات المصرفية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال المحاسبة لضمان الكفاءة في تنفيذ المهام المطلوبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها. إعداد الشجرة المحاسبية والقيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها. تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بحسب الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في المجال. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. فهم عميق للمبادئ المحاسبية وإجراءات التدقيق المالي. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المالية والتحليلات المحاسبية بدقة. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة والقدرة على إدارة الوثائق والسجلات المالية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة عبدالرحمن زايد القرموشي التجارية في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والاحترافية في التعامل مع البيانات المالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

7e10a38e2caef909.description: About Systra SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA focuses on designing safe and sustainable transport solutions to enhance social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education, and leisure worldwide. The company operates in over 80 countries, providing services from design to maintenance across the project lifecycle. Role Overview SYSTRA is seeking a Lead Architect (PMC) for a major metro project in Riyadh, with a primary focus on station architecture. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience and involves overseeing architectural aspects from design through construction within complex transportation environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong design review, multidisciplinary coordination, and project delivery expertise. Key Responsibilities Lead architectural review and coordination for metro station projects within the PMC scope. Review architectural designs, drawings, specifications, reports, and material submissions for compliance with project requirements and standards. Oversee architectural coordination with structural, civil, MEP, urban design, and specialist systems teams to ensure integrated project delivery. Monitor design development and construction progress related to architectural works across stations and associated assets. Review contractor and consultant submissions, including shop drawings, method statements, mock-ups, and material samples. Identify design issues, coordination clashes, technical risks, and constructability concerns, and support timely resolution. Participate in design review workshops, technical meetings, and stakeholder coordination sessions. Conduct site inspections and monitor architectural works to ensure compliance with approved designs, specifications, quality expectations, and project timelines. Support the management of RFIs, NCRs, change requests, and technical queries related to the architectural scope. Contribute to progress reporting, technical assessments, and client-facing PMC deliverables. Promote high standards of design quality, functionality, passenger experience, and operational suitability across station architecture. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in architectural roles, preferably within complex transportation or metro projects. Demonstrated experience in design review, multidisciplinary coordination, and project delivery. Strong understanding of architectural standards and compliance within large-scale infrastructure projects. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and is a full-time position. The Lead Architect will work within a dynamic project management consultancy (PMC) environment, collaborating with diverse teams and stakeholders on a significant metro development.

7e99e134d3e58504.description: You will own the digital-marketing data: the pipelines that bring advertising, social, web-analytics, email and app-store data into the warehouse, and the models that let the client see whether campaign spend turns into visitors and bookings. Normalise campaign, spend, impression, click and conversion data across platforms so it can be compared. Maintain the attribution and UTM models and the marketing data marts that feed the dashboards and ROI analysis. Keep the connectors healthy through API changes, rate limits and credential rotations. Work with the marketing stakeholders to define the metrics and reconcile them with platform reports. Write the monthly progress report for the marketing data stream. What you need Python connectors with pagination, rate limiting, retries and incremental loads Hands-on experience with at least two advertising or social APIs (Meta, Google Ads, Snapchat, TikTok, X) GA4 data model and the GA4 export to BigQuery Email-marketing platforms and app-store download data as sources A marketing-data connector such as Funnel.io or Supermetrics SQL and warehouse modelling for campaign and conversion data Attribution and UTM fundamentals: multi-touch models, campaign taxonomies, deduplication across platforms Good to have Google Ads and GA4 certifications Marketing-mix or incrementality modelling Arabic and regional ad platforms

7ec2a8f8c518739b.description: Job Summary Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Supervisor Housekeeping to join their team in Makkah, Mecca, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing the quality of guest rooms and public areas, managing room status reports, and coordinating daily activities within the Housekeeping Department. The Supervisor will ensure adherence to quality standards and facilitate smooth operations between various hotel departments. Key Responsibilities Inspect guest rooms, public areas, and facilities to ensure compliance with quality standards after cleaning. Prepare room availability reports, check room status, identify discrepancies, prioritize cleaning, and update departing guest statuses. Assist the Housekeeping Department in managing daily operations and coordinating efforts with Engineering, Front Office, and Laundry. Document and resolve room discrepancy issues with the Front Desk. Prepare, distribute, and communicate changes to assignment sheets or work boards, and relay all issues to the next shift. Complete all required paperwork and assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Comply with company safety policies, report maintenance issues, hazards, accidents, or injuries, and complete safety training. Ensure a neat and professional uniform and personal appearance, maintain company information privacy, and protect company assets. Support co-workers, treat them with dignity and respect, and contribute to team goals. 7e3fc0f7f5ea21f2.description: About NTT DATA NTT DATA is recognized for technical excellence and innovation, committed to making a positive impact for clients and society. Act as the primary point of contact for information security governance, risk, and compliance matters. Strong expertise in risk assessment methodologies, compliance management, audit processes, and policy development. Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders and executive leadership. 7e330e9d30ca93fe.description: About KBR and the Role KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) delivers comprehensive solutions across the entire asset lifecycle, encompassing licensed process technologies, advisory services, technical expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions for optimizing assets. 7e6ccd63ec1cbacb.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Senior Associate Brand Management to join their team in Makkah, with work locations in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves supporting brand strategy execution, performance monitoring, and guideline implementation. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. 7e70231025150da2.description: About Bristol Myers Squibb At Bristol Myers Squibb, the company's culture is centered on discovering, developing, and delivering innovative medicines to address serious diseases. The organization offers work that transforms patient lives and supports career growth within an inclusive environment that values wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. Key Responsibilities Implement market access plans and optimize Months of Inventory (MOI) for all SKUs across accounts, institutions, and distributors, collaborating with Strategic Access, Finance, Supply Chain, and distributors. Lead the tenders taskforce with all franchise teams on a weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly basis. Assist in analyzing government policies and strategies related to medicine access, Health Economic Assessment policies, and pharmaceutical spending trends, in cooperation with Market Access Lead and Government Affairs Regional/Global Leads. Maintain regular interactions with cross-functional BMS teams (Franchise Teams, Access and Govt. Affairs, Medical, Regulatory), distributors, pharmacy, planning, and purchasing departments at institutions and Health Clusters, Central Medical Supplies, regional ministry branches at MoH, NUPCO, and key private accounts. Regularly update cross-functional teams on Pharmacy and Therapeutics Committees’ status and schedule. Coach Therapeutic Area Partners (TAPs) on the process of Special Patient Requests (SPRs) and enlistment across all accounts and institutions in Saudi Arabia. Aid in developing monitoring dashboards and ensure timely data feeding. Conduct regular joint visits with TAPs to resolve access-related issues. Develop and maintain deep knowledge of the healthcare environment, trends, and emerging segments, proposing strategies to establish BMS as a partner of choice. Communicate changes concerning the environment and interact with Franchise Teams to drive competitive advantage. Required Qualifications and Skills 5-10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated communication and negotiation skills. Work Environment and Travel This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Jeddah, or Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role requires regular travel to fulfill responsibilities across various accounts and institutions.

7ee93cdcb7496678.description: نبحث عن مدير استراتيجي يتمتع برؤية ثاقبة وشغف بالابتكار لقيادة تطوير وتنفيذ الاستراتيجيات الشاملة التي تدفع نمو الشركة. ستقوم بتحديد الفرص الجديدة، وتحليل اتجاهات السوق، وقيادة مبادرات استراتيجية تضمن تحقيق أهدافنا طويلة الأجل. إذا كنت تمتلك خبرة مثبتة في وضع وتنفيذ الاستراتيجيات الناجحة، فإننا ندعوك للانضمام إلى فريقنا. * تطوير وتنفيذ خطط استراتيجية مبتكرة لتحقيق أهداف العمل. * تحليل السوق والمنافسين لتحديد الفرص والتحديات. * قيادة فرق متعددة الوظائف لضمان التنفيذ الناجح للمبادرات الاستراتيجية. * مراقبة وتقييم أداء الاستراتيجيات وتقديم التوصيات للتحسين المستمر.

7ef5be3a205efb7e.description: About MANNING GLOBAL MANNING GLOBAL is an internationally renowned staffing and managed services organization. The company specializes in providing staffing solutions for leading corporations across various sectors, including AI, IT & Telecoms, Engineering, Digital Media, Automotive, and Renewable Energy. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and requires a professional with extensive experience in civil construction project management. 7e2c691fa7b33fc9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التشييد الشرقي للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ أعمال التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة والإصلاح لأنظمة التبريد والتكييف، مع ضمان كفاءة الأداء والالتزام بمعايير السلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ أعمال تركيب وتشغيل وصيانة أجهزة وأنظمة التبريد والتكييف. فحص وحدات التبريد والتأكد من كفاءة أدائها وسلامة تشغيلها. تشخيص الأعطال الفنية وإصلاحها بفعالية. فحص الضواغط والمحركات والدوائر الكهربائية ودوائر التبريد. تنظيف الفلاتر والمكثفات والمبخرات بشكل دوري. فحص مستويات غاز التبريد ومعالجة أي تسريبات محتملة. تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الوقائية والدورية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. التأكد من الالتزام باشتراطات السلامة المهنية ومعايير الجودة. توثيق أعمال الصيانة والإصلاح بشكل دقيق. رفع التقارير الفنية عن الأعطال والاحتياجات وقطع الغيار اللازمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التبريد والتكييف. القدرة على فحص المعدات وتشخيص الأعطال الفنية ومعالجتها. المعرفة بإجراءات الصيانة الوقائية والدورية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع المهام. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل شركة التشييد الشرقي للمقاولات. تتطلب الوظيفة العمل الميداني والتعامل المباشر مع أنظمة التبريد والتكييف. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا كفني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

7e6b468bfe90a0fa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الهندسية الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب التقدم، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة قوية ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. فهم لبرامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات الصناعية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية والجودة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: الرياض نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الراتب: غير معلن التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

7eb497716e39cdd1.description: About the Role Schneider Electric is seeking a Generalist Service Representative I to join their team in Al Madinah, covering both Yanbu and Medina. This full-time position is responsible for the installation, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of customer equipment. The role requires 0-1 years of experience and involves providing technical support for Schneider Electric products, both in the shop and on-site, with potential work on competitive equipment. Key Responsibilities Comply with all safety and cybersecurity policies, practices, and procedures. Perform startup and commissioning for Schneider Electric products and potentially competitive equipment. Conduct preventive, scheduled, and unscheduled maintenance on equipment. Analyze and interpret technical procedures, governmental regulations, and equipment issues to provide appropriate solutions. Analyze and explain report results to customers and management. Participate proactively in team initiatives and management meetings to achieve departmental and company goals. Understand the scope of work, adhere to time allocations, and ensure full traceability through timesheets and change orders. Support planners, coordinators, and project managers in understanding customer site conditions. Escalate quality or technical issues detected in the field. Understand the EcoStruxure offer and provide technical explanations to customers. Utilize all digital tools designed for Schneider Electric Field Service Representatives (FSRs). Execute Field Services Operations, ensuring a high level of customer experience and promoting Schneider Electric's services. 7e7814c76267cb11.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث فندق سوفيتيل جبل عمر عن موظف استقبال فندق للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم خدمات إرشاد ومساعدة متميزة للنزلاء، وتلبية طلباتهم، وتنسيق الحجوزات والمواصلات، وتوفير المعلومات السياحية والخدمات الفندقية. يضمن شاغل الوظيفة تجربة إقامة مميزة ورضا النزلاء وفقًا لمعايير الفندق. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال النزلاء والترحيب بهم وتقديم المساعدة اللازمة أثناء إقامتهم. تقديم المعلومات المتعلقة بمرافق الفندق والخدمات المتاحة. تنسيق حجوزات المطاعم والمواصلات والجولات السياحية حسب طلب النزلاء. مساعدة النزلاء في تلبية احتياجاتهم الخاصة وتقديم التوصيات المناسبة. التعامل مع استفسارات النزلاء وطلباتهم ومتابعتها لضمان رضاهم. التنسيق مع الأقسام المعنية لضمان تقديم الخدمات بكفاءة وسرعة. تقديم معلومات دقيقة عن المعالم السياحية والمواقع المهمة في المنطقة. التعامل مع الشكاوى والملاحظات باحترافية وإحالتها إلى المسؤول المختص عند الحاجة. الالتزام بمعايير الخدمة والضيافة والمظهر المهني المعتمدة في الفندق. المحافظة على سرية معلومات النزلاء وخصوصيتهم. متابعة الطلبات الخاصة والتأكد من تنفيذها في الوقت المحدد. توثيق طلبات النزلاء والملاحظات المهمة وتسليمها للموظفين في المناوبات التالية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. مهارات تواصل قوية ولباقة في التعامل. بيئة العمل يعمل موظف الاستقبال ضمن فريق فندق سوفيتيل جبل عمر في مدينة مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الضيافة الفندقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

7ea9bab5f880a48c.company_name: مكتب د علي صالح الدهيمان للاستشارات البيئيه
7ea9bab5f880a48c.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب د علي صالح الدهيمان للاستشارات البيئيه عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقه في ضبا، تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ أعمال المعاينة وسحب العينات ضمن مشروع الهيئة العامة للغذاء والدواء، مع ضمان توثيق البيانات وتجهيزها وتسليمها للمختبرات وفقًا للإجراءات المعتمدة ومتطلبات الجودة والسلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية معاينة الإرساليات والمنتجات بدقة والتحقق من صحة بياناتها والمستندات ذات الصلة. سحب العينات وفقًا للخطط والتعليمات والإجراءات المعتمدة لضمان دقة النتائج. ترميز العينات وتسجيل بياناتها وتعبئة النماذج الخاصة بها بدقة عالية. تجهيز العينات وحفظها ونقلها بما يتوافق مع متطلبات كل نوع للحفاظ على سلامتها وجودتها. التنسيق الفعال لتسليم العينات إلى المختبرات ومتابعة توثيق استلامها. إعداد التقارير الدورية والشاملة عن أعمال المعاينة وسحب العينات. الالتزام الصارم بإجراءات الجودة والسلامة المهنية واستخدام أدوات الوقاية اللازمة. أداء أي مهام أخرى ذات صلة بطبيعة الوظيفة يكلف بها من المسؤول المباشر. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال المعاينة وسحب العينات بدقة. الالتزام بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية. المهارات والكفاءات الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في توثيق البيانات وتعبئة النماذج. القدرة على العمل ضمن إجراءات محددة والالتزام بها. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة لإدارة العينات وتجهيزها. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الدورية بوضوح. بيئة العمل يعمل مراقب الخدمات العامة بدوام كامل في ضبا، تبوك، ضمن فريق يدعم مشروع الهيئة العامة للغذاء والدواء، مع التركيز على تطبيق أعلى معايير الجودة والسلامة في جميع المهام الموكلة إليه. تقديم الطلبات إذا كنت تمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة لهذا الدور، ندعوك لتقديم طلبك.

7ee6f6515fe386bc.description: About the Role Al Khozama Investment is seeking a Restaurant General Manager to oversee all aspects of restaurant operations. Support and mentor colleagues, providing training and assistance. Maintain honesty, authenticity, and strive for excellence. Embrace and respect all cultures. 7e4d07d98d12edfb.description: Position Description The Senior HRSD Solution Architect is a senior technology leadership role responsible for defining, designing, and governing end-to-end Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD) solutions across the organization. The role will be accountable for establishing the target HRSD architecture , defining solution patterns, evaluating technology options, designing integrations with enterprise HR and corporate systems, and ensuring that implementations leverage standard platform capabilities wherever possible. The architect will provide technical governance throughout the solution lifecycle, from initial discovery and requirements through design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization. The position requires a strong combination of HR domain knowledge, ServiceNow HRSD expertise, solution architecture, integration architecture, security, and technical leadership . The successful candidate will be expected to provide strategic guidance while also being sufficiently hands-on to challenge technical designs, resolve complex architectural issues, and guide delivery teams toward high-quality solutions. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to design and govern secure, scalable, integrated, and user-centric HRSD solutions that modernize HR service delivery, improve employee experience, increase operational efficiency, and support the organization's long-term HR technology strategy. Scope of the Role The Senior HRSD Solution Architect will: Own the end-to-end technical architecture for HRSD initiatives and major enhancements. Define the current-state, target-state, and transition architecture for HR service delivery. Ensure alignment between HR business strategy, HR processes, enterprise architecture, and technology solutions. Lead architecture decisions for ServiceNow HRSD and related HR technology platforms. Define integration strategies between HRSD, HRIS, payroll, identity management, enterprise applications, and third-party systems. Establish technical standards, reusable architecture patterns, and governance principles. Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, highly available, upgradeable, and aligned with enterprise technology standards. Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to project and delivery teams. Review and approve solution designs, integrations, configurations, and technical implementations. Identify opportunities for automation, self-service, AI, and digital transformation within HR service delivery. Ensure that HRSD solutions minimize unnecessary customization and maximize the use of standard platform capabilities. Support strategic technology planning, platform roadmaps, and continuous improvement initiatives.

7e4a20b3b34d1e13.description: Job Summary Lead and manage worker welfare across Qiddiya's operational environment, ensuring safe, healthy, dignified and compliant living and working conditions for employees, contractors and service providers operating within Qiddiya-controlled assets, venues, precincts, events and public realm environments. Own the development, implementation and assurance of city-wide worker welfare standards, management systems and improvement programmes covering accommodation, transport, catering and food services, hygiene, recreation, wellbeing and workforce support services. Operational Assurance & Compliance • Lead a risk-based programme of inspections, audits and assurance activities covering accommodation, welfare facilities, transport, sanitation, water quality, pest control, housekeeping, recreational facilities, wellbeing services and workforce support arrangements. • Lead assurance of contractor and service provider compliance with Qiddiya Worker Welfare Standards through inspections, audits, performance reviews and evidence-based verification activities. • Monitor corrective actions arising from audits, inspections, complaints and investigations and ensure timely, evidenced closure. • Maintain readiness for internal, client and regulatory inspections through effective governance, reporting and record management. Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement • Develop and maintain city-wide worker welfare dashboards, KPIs and performance reports covering audit results, accommodation compliance, grievance trends, heat stress controls, contractor compliance, workforce engagement, service quality, non-conformances and corrective action closure. • Provide regular performance, risk and assurance reports to Operations leadership and relevant governance forums, including client updates where required. • Chair or participate in management reviews with Operations, Facilities Management and service providers. • Use performance data, benchmarking, worker feedback and assurance findings to drive continuous improvement across City Operations.
